Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists
 major maintenance procedures P2, which must be performed from twelve to 
 sixteen years
 as indicated by Y12:16 in the title block.
 The first draft document initiated by eng Hamza Ibrahem Aly, El-Hadaba 
 substation (220kv)
Safety Precautions
A word permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category
CB must be isolated completely and
 grounded on both sides.
Ensure that the earthling switch
 must be connected on both sides of the CB.
Safety fence (rope) with caution
 marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask,
Control power disconnected
Hydraulic test gauge, SF6 test gauge meter
Micro-ohmmeter, Blower
Acidity equipment, air 
 content equipment,
Hydraulic oil and SF6 gas if needed
Work to be Carried Out
Empty
the SF6 gas of the CB to atmosphere pressure The
line is out of service.
Dismount
the breaking unit and place it on appropriate transport base.

line is out of service.

the breaking unit and place it on appropriate transport base.

 the breaking unit to the workshop for the overhaul
